def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    cells=[(r,c,v) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) for v in [grid[r][c]] if v]
    # detect direction: diagonal (c-r const), horizontal (r const), vertical (c const)
    import collections
    def try_mode(key):
        groups=collections.defaultdict(set)
        for r,c,v in cells: groups[key(r,c)].add(v)
        # a mode is valid if each key has a single color and each color's keys... use groups
        return groups if all(len(s)==1 for s in groups.values()) else None
    modes=[('diag',try_mode(lambda r,c:c-r)),('horiz',try_mode(lambda r,c:r)),('vert',try_mode(lambda r,c:c))]
    modes=[(k,g) for k,g in modes if g]
    # pick mode with fewest groups (lines)
    k,groups=min(modes,key=lambda x:len(x[1]))
    lines={d:list(s)[0] for d,s in groups.items()}
    # minimal period p with consistency
    for p in range(1,200):
        cyc={}
        ok=True
        for d,col in lines.items():
            i=d%p
            if i in cyc and cyc[i]!=col: ok=False;break
            cyc[i]=col
        if ok: break
    f=lambda r,c: cyc[( (c-r) if k=='diag' else (r if k=='horiz' else c) )%p]
    return [[f(r,c) for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
